blocks.title: Cybersecurity awareness
blocks.text: Cybersecurity awareness means understanding and practising ways to protect yourself from online threats.
The book says cyber crime can be reported to NR3C-FIA at https://www.nr3c.gov.pk. Agencies and reporting channels can change, so check the current official channel before reporting.

blocks.prompt: Name two parts of cybersecurity awareness covered next.
blocks.explanation: Recognizing threats (phishing, malware) and protecting personal information (privacy settings, care with public posts).

items: Cybersecurity awareness: know the threats, protect your information, report cyber crime officially.
